# ShopLink – Curated Creator Deals & Product Showcase (Full Index)

> Comprehensive plain-text knowledge base and product index for AI models, autonomous agents, and search engines.

ShopLink aggregates verified recommendations from leading content creators, pairing authentic reviews with direct marketplace affiliate links across Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, and Myntra.

## Site Metadata
- Base URL: https://shoplink-beta.vercel.app/
- Primary Language: English (en-US)
- Canonical Target: https://shoplink-beta.vercel.app/
- Sitemap: https://shoplink-beta.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://shoplink-beta.vercel.app/robots.txt
- Machine Context: https://shoplink-beta.vercel.app/.well-known/webmcp.json

## Categories
1. Technology & Audio: Studio headphones, wireless earbuds, smart desk accessories, lighting.
2. Fashion & Streetwear: Vintage tees, oversized hoodies, sneakers, everyday apparel.
3. Traditional & Ethnic: Handcrafted silk sarees, festive kurtis, ethnic accessories.
4. Skincare & Beauty: Hydrating serums, dew drops, organic cosmetics, sunscreens.
5. Home & Ambiance: Minimalist sunset lamps, aroma diffusers, modern ergonomic decor.

## Agent Operations
AI agents can invoke tools registered on `document.modelContext` or submit the search form with parameters:
- `query`: Text string for fuzzy search across title, tags, and descriptions.
- `category`: Strict category matching (All, Tech, Fashion, Ethnic, Skincare, Home).
- `platform`: Target retail marketplace (All, Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra).
